extracted.name: Quick and Simple Broccoli and Cheese
extracted.description: This is an easy broccoli and cheese recipe that anyone can make. Turn eating your veggies into a treat that kids and grown ups alike will love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen broccoli florets, thawed
3 tablespoons butter, melted, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place broccoli in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water and cover. Cook until tender but still firm, 2 to 6 minutes. Drain and transfer to a microwave-safe casserole dish.
Pour melted butter over broccoli and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle cheese over the top and microwave on high until cheese is melted, about 1 minute.
